                    continue
                stack, cells = [(r, c)], []
                seen.add((r, c))
                while stack:
                    y, x = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((y, x))
                    for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                        if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy, xx))
                            stack.append((yy, xx))
                result.append(cells)

    def bounds(cells):
        return (min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells),
                max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells))

    columns.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])

    lower = [(left, color) for _, color, left, right in columns]

    groups = [upper, lower]
    heights = [max(bounds(obj)[2] - bounds(obj)[0] + 1 for obj, _ in group) for group in groups]
